name: NinjaPipe
desc: NinjaPipe CRM integration with contacts, companies, deals, tasks (under projects), pipelines, products, budgets, projects, orders, lists, and Databin webhook delivery.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact. Choose what happens if a contact with the same email already exists.

actions.name: update_contact
actions.description: Updates an existing contact by ID.

actions.name: upsert_contact
actions.description: Creates a contact or updates an existing one by email.

actions.name: toggle_client_portal
actions.description: Enable or disable client portal access for a contact. When enabling, NinjaPipe auto-generates a secure password and returns it in the response.

actions.name: create_budget_expense
actions.description: Adds an expense to a budget. The expense amount is added to the budget's spent amount.

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Creates a task or subtask in a project.

actions.name: update_task
actions.description: Updates a task within a project.

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Retrieves a single task within a project.

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: Retrieves the tasks of a project as a flat list. Use parent_id on each item to build a tree.

actions.name: delete_task
actions.description: Deletes a task within a project. Subtasks may cascade.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Creates a new order. Line items, currency, and custom fields go in Settings JSON.

actions.name: send_to_databin
actions.description: Sends a JSON payload to a Databin webhook URL on your connected NinjaPipe workspace.

actions.name: add_to_list
actions.description: Adds a contact OR a company to a CRM list. The list type must match (Contact lists accept contacts, Company lists accept companies). Idempotent — returns already_in_list:true if already present.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a new contact is created.

triggers.name: new_company
triggers.description: Triggers when a new company is created.

triggers.name: new_deal
triggers.description: Triggers when a new deal is created.

triggers.name: new_task
triggers.description: Triggers when a new task is created in the selected project.

triggers.name: new_or_updated_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a contact is created or updated.

triggers.name: new_or_updated_company
triggers.description: Triggers when a company is created or updated.

triggers.name: new_or_updated_deal
triggers.description: Triggers when a deal is created or updated.

triggers.name: new_or_updated_task
triggers.description: Triggers when a task in the selected project is created or updated.
